::: {.callout-warning title="Outline"}
This page is a map for future documentation, not a complete interface contract.
:::

## Purpose

Explain how the NADABAS add-in interacts with Excel, registered workbooks,
documents, UserForms, events, and the VBA project object model.

## Planned content

- add-in startup and shutdown events;
- workbook and document registration;
- ribbon commands and UserForm entry points;
- load and save sequences;
- event handling and global state;
- import/export tooling and CRLF requirements;
- macro security, signing, and Trust Center prerequisites;
- functional verification that cannot run in GitHub Actions.

## Source-of-truth rule

The files below `vba/` are the version-controlled source. Excel add-ins and
workbooks are build or release artifacts. A behavioural description is complete
only when it references the relevant exported component and a repeatable test or
manual verification step.
